::: {#exr-union-bound}
#### Indicator of a union

For events $A_1, \ldots, A_k$, let $\indic{A}$ be the indicator of the event $A$:
it equals 1 if $A$ occurs and 0 if it does not.
Show that, for every outcome,

$$\indic{A_1 \cup \cdots \cup A_k} \le \indic{A_1} + \cdots + \indic{A_k}.$$

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

::: {#sol-union-bound}

Fix an outcome and consider two cases.

- If none of $A_1, \ldots, A_k$ occurs,
  then the union does not occur,
  so the left side is $0$ and the right side is $0 + \cdots + 0 = 0$.
  The inequality holds with equality.
- If at least one $A_j$ occurs,
  then the union occurs, so the left side is $1$.
  The right side is a sum of $k$ terms, each $0$ or $1$,
  and at least one of them is $1$,
  so the right side is at least $1$.
  The inequality holds.

:::
